subtopics.definition: Complaints about too many ads, ad frequency, or ad volume interrupting music.
subtopics.name: Excessive or loud ads

subtopics.definition: Complaints that basic controls like skip, previous, shuffle, or queue access are blocked or limited for free users.
subtopics.name: Restricted playback controls

subtopics.definition: Complaints that songs play in random order or that specific song selection is not possible.
subtopics.name: Forced or random shuffle

subtopics.definition: Complaints about inability to rewind, seek to a specific part, or repeat a song section.
subtopics.name: Seeking and repeat problems

subtopics.definition: Complaints about disliking new layout, design, or homescreen update changes.
subtopics.name: UI or homescreen redesign complaints

subtopics.definition: Complaints about automatically playing audio/video elements with no way to disable them.
subtopics.name: Unwanted autoplay audio/video

subtopics.definition: Complaints about broken features like volume adjustment not working properly.
subtopics.name: UI/control bugs

subtopics.definition: Complaints about the app crashing, freezing, or getting stuck on loading screens.
subtopics.name: App crashes or freezes

subtopics.definition: Complaints about music stopping halfway, not resuming, or skipping to a new song unexpectedly.
subtopics.name: Playback stopping or skipping unexpectedly

subtopics.definition: Complaints about Spotify not playing music when triggered via Google Assistant or similar voice assistants.
subtopics.name: Voice assistant integration failure

subtopics.definition: Complaints about failure to connect or stream over certain networks like wifi.
subtopics.name: Network connectivity issues

subtopics.definition: Complaints that offline or downloaded music playback does not function.
subtopics.name: Offline mode not working

subtopics.definition: Complaints about downloaded songs disappearing or needing to be redownloaded repeatedly.
subtopics.name: Forced re-downloading

subtopics.definition: Complaints that specific songs or artists are not available in the catalog.
subtopics.name: Missing songs or artists

subtopics.definition: Complaints about insufficient variety within a specific music genre, such as gospel.
subtopics.name: Limited genre selection

subtopics.definition: Complaints that lyrics are missing or inconsistently shown for songs.
subtopics.name: Inconsistent lyrics availability

subtopics.definition: Complaints about unwanted, excessive, or declining quality of personalized recommendations.
subtopics.name: Recommendation and discovery quality

subtopics.definition: Complaints that basic playback features like skip or song choice now require a Premium subscription.
subtopics.name: Core features locked behind Premium

subtopics.definition: Complaints specifically about a numeric cap on how many songs can be skipped without Premium.
subtopics.name: Skip limit for free users

subtopics.definition: Complaints that a recent app update removed features that used to be available without paying.
subtopics.name: Update removed previously free features
